method: manual visual transcription from the exact supplied images using view_image, requested detail original and returned detail original for each of 15 calls. Read review-protocol.md, then preflight.json; its images array was empty. Saved reviews/craft-action-first.json with unchanged empty viewed/readings arrays and read it back through exec_command before opening packet.json. Then read the full request, copy, conditions, and sets. Actual view order: X8499 native/usage720/thumbnail320, X6711 native/usage720/thumbnail320, X2792 native/usage720/thumbnail320, X4143 native/usage720/thumbnail320, X1542 native/usage720/thumbnail320. Each provided string was manually read from pixels; only whitespace was normalized for equality. No OCR, crop, image modification, web, connector, agent, skill, other profile, or outside directory was used. PNG headers were read without changing files to check dimensions: every native is 1024x1536 and usage720 is 720x1080, both exactly 2:3; every thumbnail is 213x320, 0.15625% ratio error, within 1%. No tool error or reported detail downgrade occurred. The rendered view does not establish the origin of faint surface variation or distinguish every gray edge fringe from antialiasing; those uncertainties are retained. Pixels do not establish authorship, physical materials, or printing performance. The unchanged supplied rubric and AI-slop inspection detail were applied throughout. Closest-pair score uses the diversity scale: 1 means nearly repetitive and 5 means strongly distinct, not a quality score. No total or average was computed.
